# Summary

Describe the problem, approach and related issue/epic.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant tests and formatting/lint pass (list commands and platforms).
- [ ] Behavioral changes include a regression test.
- [ ] Public behavior and compatibility changes are documented.
- [ ] No credentials, private data or generated binaries are included.

## Limitations

List untested platforms or known follow-up work. Maintainers synchronize roadmap and execution-plan status before merge.
